name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an LDAP Query ('LDAP Injection')
principle: Untrusted data is inserted into an LDAP query without proper escaping or structural separation. Attackers can change filter logic, bypass authentication, enumerate entries, or read/modify directory data.
detection_signals: User-controlled data concatenated or formatted into an LDAP filter string before DirContext.search(), InitialDirContext.search(), LdapTemplate.search(), ldap_search(), or DirectorySearcher.Filter
Authentication filters built as strings, e.g. "(&(uid=" + user + ")(userPassword=" + pass + "))"
Input from HttpServletRequest.getParameter(), request headers, form fields, cookies, or socket reads reaches an LDAP query sink
Raw LDAP metacharacters such as (, ), *, &, |, !, or \ appear in query assembly with no escaping step
No call to an LDAP-specific escape API such as escapeLDAPSearchFilter(), LdapEncoder.filterEncode(), or equivalent before the sink
StringBuilder/plus concatenation used to build the query instead of a structured LDAP filter API
negative_signals: Query uses only constant filter literals with no external input
Untrusted value is passed through LDAP filter escaping before interpolation
Structured filter API is used with separate attribute and value arguments, not raw string assembly
Input is validated against a strict allowlist of fixed identifiers and mapped to constant filter fragments
No path from external input to any LDAP search or directory lookup sink
false_defense_traps: Stripping only a few characters such as '(' and ')' while leaving '*' , '&' , '|' , or '\\' unescaped
Using URL encoding, HTML escaping, or SQL escaping instead of LDAP escaping
Validating after the filter string is already concatenated
Blacklists that remove known payloads but do not enforce a strict allowlist
verification_focus: Does any external input reach an LDAP search/filter sink without LDAP-specific escaping or a structured query API?

consequence_chains.trigger: user-controlled filter fragments alter authentication or authorization predicates
consequence_chains.consequence: authentication bypass or unauthorized directory access

consequence_chains.trigger: search filters can be widened to return unintended directory entries

patch_principle: Never concatenate untrusted data into LDAP filter strings
Use LDAP-specific escaping for filter context, and DN escaping only when building DNs
Prefer structured or parameterized LDAP APIs over raw query strings
Apply strict allowlist validation for identifiers and reject unexpected characters

minimal_examples.vuln: String filter = "(uid=" + user + ")"; ctx.search(base, filter, ctls);
minimal_examples.safe: String filter = "(uid=" + LdapEncoder.filterEncode(user) + ")"; ctx.search(base, filter, ctls);
